propositions: Pause and resume operations maintain backward compatibility with old readers by preserving gated_mode field and accepting dual-format remote refs
Pause blocks before lock acquisition or ticket mutation and returns rc 0 with exact anchored JSON-decoded BRIDGE_PAUSED marker; workflow skips commit-and-push only when this marker is present

Pause provenance enforces repository git user.email and first-pause UTC RFC3339 timestamp; same-reason pause is idempotent and preserves metadata; different reason, blank reason, missing identity, or CAS conflict refuse without overwrite
Resume safely clears observed ref OID via CAS and recovers corrupt blobs without decoding; corrupt state emits clean rc 1 without traceback

Ordinary rc 0, malformed or unanchored markers, corrupt rc 1, and legacy gate rc 4 retain existing behavior; pre-gate reconcile-check early return and old rebar reconcile --mode vocabulary remain functional
